title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes - Taylor Hart
content:
Release train weekly prep - personal notes (working doc)
Date: 2026-03-18
Owner: Taylor Hart (release engineer)
Attendees (planned): Maya S., Ethan P., Olivia M., Samir P. (optional), Product PM (TBD)
Meeting goal: final go/no-go readiness check for 2026-03-25 feature push + infra migration window on 03-26. Make call on canary schedule and rollback plan.

Quick status summary (my read):
- Feature branch merged to release-candidate on 03-16. Basic e2e pass but flaky auth tests (see REL-3421).
- Infra migration (KV cache change) blocked by perf regression in staging; infra running profiling (INFRA-889).
- Docs mostly ready but some end-user flag text missing (DOCS-178).
- Dedicated capacity reservation confirmed for 03-25 evening window.

High-priority checklist (go/no-go) - call will tick these off:
1) Core e2e tests green on release-candidate (owner: QA - Maya S.) - status: amber (flaky auth).
2) Canaries defined and automation in place (owner: SRE - Ethan P.) - status: green (canary jobs exist, need runbook update).
3) Rollback playbook approved and smoke rollback tested in staging (owner: Release - Taylor H.) - status: amber (partial smoke).
4) Infra perf regression mitigated or has acceptable workaround (owner: Infra - Olivia M.) - status: red (profiling ongoing).
5) Feature flags and targeting verified in prod config (owner: Product Ops) - status: green (flags created but not yet reviewed).
6) Customer-facing docs + release notes ready (owner: Docs - Priya K.) - status: amber (DOCS-178 outstanding).
7) Capacity and cost window signed (owner: Finance/GTM) - status: green.
8) Security review sign-off for data path changes (owner: Security) - status: green.

Notes / evidence to bring to the call:
- REL-3421: auth e2e flakes reproduce reliably under parallel test run 8+; suspected race in token refresh path. Maya will bring logs and minimal repro script.
- INFRA-889: KV cache change increases median latency +12% in staging for p95 traffic; infra profiling team to present flamegraphs. If not fixed by end of day 03-19, fallback plan is to gate KV change to next train and ship features without migration.
- Canary plan: two-region canary (us-west/us-east), 5% traffic for 2 hours, automatic rollback on >1.5x error rate or >30% latency increase. Runbook link: Confluence:Release-Playbook-2026-Q1 (bring to meeting).

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we gate the KV migration out of this train if perf fix not confirmed by 03-19 EOD? (pro: avoid regression; con: delays infra benefits).
- If auth e2e flaky remains, acceptable to proceed with canary but require manual verification on auth flows? (risk: customer login failures).
- Confirm on-call rotations during canary window (need volunteers).

Action items (pre-meeting items I will track):
- Taylor: run targeted smoke rollback in staging and capture checklist (due 03-19) -> partial, need one more run.
- Taylor: prepare short summary slide with canary thresholds + rollback steps (due 03-19).
- Maya: reproduce auth flake and attach repro steps to REL-3421 (due 03-19).
- Olivia: share perf flamegraphs and quick mitigation plan (due 03-19 EOD).
- Priya: finalize docs + highlight missing paragraphs for review (due 03-20).
- Ethan: verify canary automation runs in dry-run mode and confirm alerting hooks (due 03-19).

Meeting agenda (15-20m):
- Quick TL;DR status (2m)
- Infra perf report + decision on KV migration (5-7m)
- QA auth flake evidence and mitigation (5m)
- Canary + rollback runbook review (3m)
- Final go/no-go call and owners for canary watch (2m)

Risk register (brief):
- Auth flake (priority: high) -> can cause login/flows to fail under load. Mitigation: limit canary traffic + manual auth smoke test.
- KV migration perf (priority: high) -> could raise p95 latency; mitigation: gate migration or increase target instance sizes during window.
- Docs/communication gaps (priority: medium) -> mitigation: hold a quick external comms review before ship.

Notes to self (informal):
- Bring up possibility of soft-launch to internal tenants only if infra risk remains.
- If we gate KV, ensure we have a clear ticket to pick it up in next train and list blockers.
- Keep product PM in loop; need sign-off for gating decision.

Follow-ups after call (expected):
- Consolidated decision entry in REL-3421 and add postmortem checklist if we ship with known flakes.
- Schedule quick runbook walkthrough with on-call SREs 03-24.

---
This is a working scratchpad. Will copy notes into the release train doc after meeting and update REL-3421/INFRA-889.
